pages.title: Uranus
pages.text: An ice giant that spins lying on its side. You cannot land on it. Land on Miranda with a tier 5 rocket. Ariel, Umbriel, Titania and Oberon only stay on the map.

pages.title: Miranda
pages.text: Its surface looks stitched from patches. Gravity is about 29% of Earth's. It is very cold. Resources abound: iron, dolomite, diamonds, quartz, cobalt and nickel. Cobalt is used for armor and the Protection module.

pages.title: Cobalt
pages.text: A metal from Miranda for armor and the Protection module.
